```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)
fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

print(wildfires)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- jsonlite::read_json("data/wildfires.geojson") |>
  pluck("features") |>
  tibble(features = _) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) mean(map_dbl(polygon[[1]], 1))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(polygon) mean(map_dbl(polygon[[1]], 2))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_ten_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    geometry = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) sf::st_polygon(map(rings, \(ring) do.call(rbind, map(ring, unlist))))
    ),
    popup_text = paste0(
      incident, " (", fire_year, "): ",
      scales::comma(gis_acres), " acres"
    )
  ) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry", crs = 4326)

bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_ten_fires)

leaflet(top_ten_fires) |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~popup_text,
    color = "#7f0000",
    fillColor = "#d7301f",
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1
  ) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = bounds[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = bounds[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = bounds[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```
